subject.title: macOS chat window: native redesign with sessions sidebar, toolbar pickers, slash commands, context usage

question: Should this issue be the canonical macOS chat redesign epic, and which implementation slice should land first?
rationale: The request spans native app UX, session management semantics, command discovery, and toolbar/context affordances; source confirms gaps, but the exact scope and sequencing need maintainer product ownership.

options.title: Scope as staged redesign epic
options.body: Use this issue as the umbrella and split first work into transport parity, sessions sidebar shell, and composer/actions PRs.

options.title: Narrow to transport parity first
options.body: Start with commands.list and sessions.create/patch/delete wiring, then reopen the visual redesign once the RPC base is proven.

options.title: Defer behind Apple session PR
options.body: Wait for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101053 to settle, then re-scope the remaining native chat gaps.

recommendation.title: Scope as staged redesign epic
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the umbrella and split first work into transport parity, sessions sidebar shell, and composer/actions PRs.
